answer: Duplicate registrations share one willow-rooted identity tree keyed to the attesters, so a fake cluster collapses like an echo of the same voice. A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a bond locked behind a verifiable identity bridge, where a new agent must be attested by three distinct existing agents who each stake tokens. An attacker must either corrupt three independent stakers (cost: 3x bond plus slashing risk) or forfeit their stake, making mass sybils economically irrational. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
